verdicts.reason: A: the headline is squeezed into a narrow column at one word per line ('Six / weeks / of / open / studios'). The schedule is out of order and uneven: 13 JAN and 20 JAN are large while the other four sessions are tiny and staggered at different heights, so the list can't be read. The logo is also tiny. B: the headline is large and clearly the main focus, and the image keeps its proportions. But the CTA is jammed against the left edge, and the six sessions are scattered in tiny, out-of-order pieces around all the edges. The logo is shrunk to a speck next to the legal line at the bottom. Both fail, but B keeps the headline hierarchy, which A loses.
